verdict.rationale: xAI documents a dated retirement guide (May 15, 2026) that names the retired slugs in advance and explains an automatic redirect to grok-4.3. Model aliases support pinned versus moving IDs. This is a single event-specific migration guide, not a standing deprecation policy with a guaranteed notice period, so coverage is partial. Missing for 10: a published general deprecation policy with a committed minimum notice window, migration guidance beyond the redirect (e.g., behavioral or output differences to test), and independent or hands-on corroboration of notice timing.

support.subject: As a developer, I can rely on a documented deprecation policy with advance notice and migration guidance before a model I depend on is retired

citations.quote: requests to the retired model slugs above will automatically redirect to `grok-4.3`. The slugs themselves continue to resolve, so you do not need to change your code
`<modelname>` is aliased to the latest stable version. `<modelname>-latest` is aliased to the latest version
